easyPrerequisites: There are legal target(s) for Splash Portal.
description:
Cast Splash Portal by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Splash Portal, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Splash Portal, blinking Naru Meha.
Repeat from step 3.
